info.title: Dragon Star Curier — API v1
info.description:
The Dragon Star Curier shipping API.

## Authentication

Every request needs an API key, sent either as
`Authorization: Bearer <key>` or as `X-Api-Key: <key>`. If both are
present, `Authorization` wins.

Keys are issued from your account, under Settings → API access. Each
key is tied to the public IP addresses it may be used from: a request
arriving from anywhere else is refused with 403.

## Rate limits

Limits apply per API key and per route, and a request may hit either
of them:

| Method | Per second | Per minute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | 40 | 1200 |
| Others | 20 | 600 |

Every response carries `X-RateLimit-Limit` and `X-RateLimit-Remaining`
for whichever limit is closest to being exceeded. On breach you get
`429` with `code: rate_limit_exceeded` and `Retry-After` in seconds
(`1` for the per-second limit, `60` for the per-minute one).

Public routes (the documentation, the liveness probe and any unknown
path) have a separate, much stricter limit: 2 requests per
second and 30 per minute, per IP address. Repeatedly
probing unknown paths gets the address temporarily banned: `429` with
`code: temporarily_banned`, for 5 minutes after 5 breaches,
10 minutes after 10 and one hour after 20.

## Errors

Errors follow [RFC 9457](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9457) and
are served as `Content-Type: application/problem+json`. Branch on the
`code` field, which is stable; `detail` is prose for a human and may
change.

## Conventions

- Timestamps are ISO 8601 with a UTC offset (`2026-09-07T15:25:28+03:00`).
- Tracking events are ordered newest first.
- Amounts are JSON numbers, in RON.
- A shipment's trail is capped at 100 events.
- A batch tracking request accepts at most 100 AWBs.

tags.name: Shipments
tags.description: Create, track, label and delete AWBs

tags.name: Manifests
tags.description: Closing shipments into a handover manifest

201.description: AWB created. The Location header points at the shipment.

post.summary: Create an AWB on behalf of a branch
post.description: As `/v1/awb`, but the sender is the branch named by `pcId`.

post.summary: Estimate the cost of a shipment
post.description: Creates nothing. Available only to accounts with price estimates enabled.

post.summary: Estimate the cost for a branch

post.description: POST because a list of AWBs does not fit in a query string. AWBs that are unknown, or belong to another client, are listed in `notFound`.

parameters.name: events
parameters.description: Include each shipment trail. Status only by default. Accepted values: `true`, `false`, `1`, `0`; anything else gets `422`.

200.description: The results, in the order requested

get.description: The current status plus the checkpoint trail, ordered newest first.

parameters.name: events
parameters.description: Pass `false` for a status-only response. Accepted values: `true`, `false`, `1`, `0`; anything else gets `422`.

delete.description: Possible only while the shipment has not been picked up, has not been closed into a manifest and has not been invoiced. After any of these, the response is `409` with code `awb_not_deletable`.

409.description: The shipment can no longer be deleted (code `awb_not_deletable`): it was picked up, closed into a manifest or invoiced.

get.summary: Track the return leg of a shipment

200.description: The return shipments linked to this AWB

get.description: With no size in the path, the one set on the account is used.

get.summary: Download the PDF label in a given size

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Paper size, spelled exactly as listed: `A4` or `A6`. Case matters, and `a4` matches no route. Leave the segment out of the path to use the size set on the account.

get.summary: Download the ZPL label for one parcel
get.description: Raw ZPL, laid out for a 100×150 mm label at 203 DPI. It carries the label content only (`^XA`…`^XZ`), with no setup commands such as `^PW` or `^LL`: width, length and darkness come from the printer settings, which must be configured for this format.

parameters.name: nb
parameters.description: The parcel number within the shipment, from 1 to `pieces`. `1` is the main parcel and carries the AWB barcode; from `2` up, the barcode gets the parcel suffix (`70000001-002`). A value greater than `pieces` is rejected with a `422` and the message `AWB {awb} has only {pieces} parcels`.

post.summary: Order a pickup for a branch
Close shipments into a new manifest
post.description: With no un-manifested shipments the response is 200 with a null `manifestId`. Shipments closed into a manifest can no longer be deleted.

200.description: The counties, keyed by code: the key is the code (`CJ`), the value is the name (`Cluj`). The **value** (the name) is used everywhere in the API, both in request bodies and in the `/v1/counties/{county}/localities` path.

get.summary: List the localities of a county
get.description: A county missing from the nomenclature gets `404` with code `county_not_found`; a valid county with no localities would get `200` and an empty list.

parameters.name: county
parameters.description: The county name, i.e. a **value** from `/v1/counties` (`Cluj`), not the key (`CJ`). Case and diacritics do not matter.

get.summary: List the localities of a county, with their distance in km
get.description: A county missing from the nomenclature gets `404` with code `county_not_found`; a valid county with no localities would get `200` and an empty list.

parameters.name: county
parameters.description: The county name, i.e. a **value** from `/v1/counties` (`Cluj`), not the key (`CJ`). Case and diacritics do not matter.

get.description: The branches the master account may ship on behalf of.

bearerAuth.description: The API key, sent as a bearer token.

type.description: Identifies the kind of error. Stable, but not an address meant to be fetched.

code.description: Stable, machine-readable code. Branch on this.

errors.description: Present on `validation_failed`: messages keyed by the field you sent.

weight: required if shipmentType = parcel or pallet

statusCode.description: The shipment status code at this event. Values: 1=Generated, 2=Attempt to delivery, 3=Delivered, 4=Notified, 5=Taken, 6=In transit, 7=Returned, 18=Out for delivery, 19=Onforwarded, 21=In final warehouse.

TrackingStatus.description: The current status, shaped like an entry in `events`.

statusCode.description: Stable shipment status code, safe to branch on. Values: 1=Generated, 2=Attempt to delivery, 3=Delivered, 4=Notified, 5=Taken, 6=In transit, 7=Returned, 18=Out for delivery, 19=Onforwarded, 21=In final warehouse.

events.description: The trail, newest first. Absent when `events=false`.

isListRate.description: True when the public list price was used rather than a negotiated rate.

awb.description: The generated AWB number the shipment is tracked by.

weight.description: The weight actually recorded. It may differ from the one sent: for envelopes it is always the fixed one.

pieces.description: The number of pieces actually recorded. For envelopes and pallets it is always 1.

codPaymentType.description: The COD payment type actually recorded. It may differ from the one sent: depending on the account setup, `cash` can become `account` and the other way round. It is `null` when there is no COD.

shipmentType.description: The kind of shipment. It decides which fields are required and which limits apply: a parcel needs `weight` and `pieces`, a pallet only `weight`, an envelope neither.

weight.description: Weight in kg. Required for parcels and pallets. Parcel: 1–9999 kg. Pallet: 20–9999 kg. For envelopes it is ignored: the price is fixed and the recorded weight is always 0.5 kg, whatever you send.

recipientCounty.description: The county name, i.e. a **value** from `/v1/counties` (`Cluj`), not the key (`CJ`). Case and diacritics do not matter.

recipientCity.description: The recipient locality, as listed by `/v1/counties/{county}/localities`. Case and diacritics do not matter.

length.description: Length in cm. If you send any of length, width or height, all three become required.

codPaymentType.description: How the COD amount is collected. Required when `codAmount` is greater than 0. Depending on the account setup, the recorded value may differ from the one sent (see `codPaymentType` in the response).

insuredValue.description: The declared value of the shipment. Adds a contract-defined percentage to the price.

returnDocuments.description: Return the accompanying documents, signed by the recipient. Adds a surcharge.

returnPackaging.description: Return the packaging to the sender. Adds a surcharge.

returnParcel.description: Return a parcel to the sender. Adds a surcharge.

smsNotification.description: Requires `recipientPhone` to be a mobile number.

deliverToBranch.description: Deliver to the courier branch instead of the recipient address. Adds the contract-defined charge to the price.

reverseShipment.description: Reverse shipment. Not compatible with `codPaymentType: account`.

recipientName.description: The recipient name, printed on the label.

recipientAddress.description: The delivery address, printed on the label.

recipientContact.description: The contact person at the destination, if different from the recipient.

recipientPhone.description: The recipient phone. It becomes required, and its format checked, only when `smsNotification` is on: it must then be a mobile number (`07XXXXXXXX`), since an SMS cannot reach a landline. Otherwise it is taken as sent.

pickupDate.description: Pickup date, `Y-m-d`. Cannot be in the past.

pickupWindowEnd.description: The hour the pickup window closes.

pickupLocation.description: When filled in, the address below becomes required.

pickupCounty.description: The county name, i.e. a **value** from `/v1/counties` (`Cluj`), not the key (`CJ`). Case and diacritics do not matter.

pickupCity.description: The pickup locality, as listed by `/v1/counties/{county}/localities`.

pickupContact.description: The contact person for the pickup.

pickupPhone.description: The contact phone for the pickup.

pickupEmail.description: The contact email for the pickup.

weight.description: The total weight to collect, in kg.

volume.description: The total volume to collect, in cubic metres.

BadRequest.description: The request body could not be read as a JSON object.
